note: P4324 (Pro 28:14) — blessed is he who fears always; who hardens his heart falls into calamity.

dims.v: reverent dread — the blessed, continual fear of the LORD
the fearing of the LORD always — the continual, reverent dread of God that keeps a man from evil and is pronounced blessed, the opposite of the hardened heart
the hardened heart it is set against (266563)
set against the heart that hardens and falls
pachad (fear/dread) — 'blessed is the one who FEARS the LORD always'; a heart kept in continual reverent awe of God is blessed and safe. The fear of the LORD is a perpetual guard (cf 23:17; 28:14b).
obduracy — the hard heart that falls into calamity
the hardening of the heart — the obduracy that refuses to fear God and reverence his word, and so falls headlong into calamity, the ruin of the unfearing
the reverent fear it is set against (266560)
set against the blessed fear of the LORD
qashah (harden) — 'but whoever HARDENS his heart will fall into calamity'; the heart hardened against God and correction runs to its own ruin. Obduracy is the road to disaster (cf 29:1).
